title: 지방교육행정기관의 행정기구와 정원기준 등에 관한 규정 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00002:20130520:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 지방교육행정기관의 행정기구와 정원기준 등에 관한 규정 시행규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Rule No. 2, May 20, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on June 12, 2013.

Article 2 (Amendment to Other Statutes or Regulations)
The Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on Training, etc. of Teachers shall be partially amended as follows:

In the former part of Article 4 (1), "Article 2 (2) through (4) of the Educational Officials Act (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act')" shall be replaced with "Article 2 (3) through (5) of the Educational Officials Act (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act')", and in paragraph (6) of the same Article and Article 4-2 (5), "educational professionals" shall be replaced with "educational professional officials".
